findings.body: New evidence beyond the previous path, whitespace and UTF-8 cases: an otherwise valid entry with `text: ""` and its matching key passes this check because whitespace normalization also produces `""`. Close therefore reviews and preserves an entry with no problem text, although item 1 requires one sentence and refusal of invalid field values. Require nonempty normalized text and cover this case through `forge close`, asserting the bad refusal and no review call.
findings.title: Not done: refuse every unreadable spotted list
